about: Hand-written facts from the free-text comments in Movebank's individual records (owner: 'super interesting', 2026-09-29; curated 2026-10-01 by Claude). Each note quotes the comment it rests on; pipeline/build_individuals.py stops if the quote is no longer in the record. Nest and hatch places are left out (R14). Skipped: mb-2943485-2943520 ('bicolored aux, red/black', the meaning of the marker is not clear from the record) and 'Seems to be a rather young bird' (a guess in the record). All nine comments were re-fetched from Movebank on 2026-10-01 and matched the cache. Tagging month of Marina and Nina (both 2024-06-13, timestamp_start) and tracking end dates for the eagle notes from pipeline/individuals.json (both 2007-02). No pronouns for the animals in German, and none in English where the sex is not in the record's sex field.

notes.en: Marina and Nina were tagged in the same nest in June 2024; Marina was the smaller of the two chicks.
notes.de: Marina und Nina wurden im Juni 2024 im selben Nest besendert; Marina war das kleinere der beiden Küken.

mb-7249090-7541652.who: Peregrine Falcon, adult female, north-west Greenland

notes.en: Tagged as an adult in north-west Greenland, this falcon was followed on two full trips south and one back north.
notes.de: Als erwachsenes Weibchen in Nordwestgrönland besendert; verfolgt auf zwei ganzen Zügen nach Süden und einem zurück.
notes.quote: adult female, tagged northwest Greenland, 2 complete outward migrations, 1 complete return migration

mb-186178781-2842545544.who: European Honey Buzzard found in Reutlingen

notes.en: Found weak in Reutlingen in May 2023, this honey buzzard was nursed back to health and set free with its tracker in June.
notes.de: Im Mai 2023 geschwächt in Reutlingen gefunden, wurde dieser Wespenbussard gesund gepflegt und im Juni mit Sender freigelassen.
notes.quote: found in weak condition 2023-05-29 in Reutlingen (Germany); After care in Vogelschutzzentrum Mössingen released there with logger on 2023-06-20

notes.en: This honey buzzard flew into a window near Stuttgart in May 2023 and was back in the wild, apparently healthy, 11 days later.
notes.de: Dieser Wespenbussard prallte im Mai 2023 bei Stuttgart gegen ein Fenster und war elf Tage später wieder frei, offenbar gesund.
notes.quote: Window collision near Stuttgart, brought to Moessingen bird care centre 2023-05-06, released apparently healthy from there 2023-05-17.

mb-2943485-2943519.who: Bald Eagle seen in New Jersey

notes.en: Tracked until 2007, this eagle was seen alive in New Jersey ten years later, in March 2017, its transmitter long gone.
notes.de: Bis 2007 besendert, wurde dieser Adler zehn Jahre später, im März 2017, lebend in New Jersey gesehen, längst ohne Sender.
notes.quote: seen alive in New Jersey on 3/29/2017 (after PTT was removed)

mb-2943485-2943518.who: Bald Eagle seen in Massachusetts and Connecticut

notes.en: Tracked until 2007, this eagle was seen alive again without its transmitter: in Massachusetts in 2011, in Connecticut in 2013.
notes.de: Bis 2007 besendert, wurde dieser Adler ohne Sender wieder lebend gesehen: 2011 in Massachusetts, 2013 in Connecticut.
notes.quote: seen alive in MA on 2/11/2011 and in CT on 3/12/2013 (after PTT was removed)
